menus.name: Assembly_CreateAssembly
menus.tip:
New Assembly (A)

Creates an assembly object in the current document, or in the current active assembly (if

any). Limit of one root assembly per file.

Assembly_CreateAssembly

menus.name: Assembly_Insert
menus.tip: Insert Component

menu.tip:
Insert Component (I)

Inserts a component into the active assembly. This will create dynamic links to parts, bodies, primitives, and assemblies. To insert external components, make sure that the file is open in the current session

  • Insert by left clicking items in the list.
  • Remove by right clicking items in the list.
  • Press shift to add several instances of the component while clicking on the view.

Assembly_InsertLink

New Part (P)

Insert a new part into the active assembly. The new part's origin can be positioned in the

assembly.

Assembly_InsertNewPart

menus.name: Part_LinkArrays
menus.tip: Link Arrays

menu.name: Part_LinkArrayCircular
menu.tip:
Circular Link Array

Creates a concentric circular array of linked objects

Part_LinkArrayCircular

menu.name: Part_LinkArrayLinear
menu.tip:
Linear Link Array

Creates a linear array of linked objects

Part_LinkArrayLinear

menu.name: Part_LinkArrayPath
menu.tip:
Path Link Array

Creates an array of linked objects along a path

Part_LinkArrayPath

menu.name: Part_LinkArrayPoint
menu.tip:
Point Link Array

Creates an array of linked objects at each point of a sketch or shape

Part_LinkArrayPoint

menu.name: Part_LinkArrayPolar
menu.tip:
Polar Link Array

Creates a polar array of linked objects

Part_LinkArrayPolar

menus.name: Assembly_SolveAssembly
menus.tip:
Solve Assembly (Z)

Solves the currently active assembly.

Assembly_SolveAssembly

menus.name: Assembly_CreateView
menus.tip:
Exploded View (E)

Creates an exploded view of the current assembly

Assembly_CreateView

menus.name: Assembly_CreateSnapshot
menus.tip:
Snapshot

Captures the current assembly state (placements and visibility). Double-clicking the Snapshot

object restores the assembly to that state.

Assembly_CreateSnapshot

menus.name: Assembly_CreateSimulation
menus.tip:
Simulation (V)

Creates a new simulation of the current assembly

Assembly_CreateSimulation

menus.name: Assembly_CreateBom
menus.tip:
Bill of Materials (O)

Creates a bill of materials of the current assembly. If an assembly is active, it will be a BOM of this assembly. Else it will be a BOM of the whole document.

The BOM object is a document object that stores the settings of your BOM. It is also a spreadsheet object so you can easily visualize the BOM. If you do not need the BOM object to be saved as a document object, you can simply export and cancel the task.

The columns 'Index', 'Name', 'File Name' and 'Quantity' are automatically generated on recompute. The 'Description' and custom columns are not overwritten.

Assembly_CreateBom

menus.name: Assembly_LinkSelectLinked
menus.tip:
Go to Linked Assembly (S, G)

Selects the linked assembly and switches to its original document

Assembly_LinkSelectLinked

menus.name: Assembly_ExportASMT
menus.tip:
Export ASMT File

Export currently active assembly as a ASMT file.

Assembly_ExportASMT

menus.name: Assembly_SelectJointsOfComponent
menus.tip:
Select Component Joints

Selects all joints referencing the selected component

Assembly_SelectJointsOfComponent

menus.name: Assembly_ToggleGrounded
menus.tip:
Toggle Grounded (G)

Toggles the grounding of a part.

Grounding a part permanently locks its position in the assembly, preventing any movement or rotation.

Assembly_ToggleGrounded

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointRigidGroup
menus.tip:
Create Rigid Group (Y)

Create a rigid group.

Creates a rigid group that permanently locks the selected components together.

Assembly_CreateJointRigidGroup

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointFixed
menus.tip:
Fixed Joint (F)

1 - If an assembly is active : Creates a joint statically locking two parts together, preventing any movement or rotation

2 - If a part is active: Positions sub-parts by matching selected coordinate systems. The second part selected will move.

Assembly_CreateJointFixed

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointRevolute
menus.tip:
Revolute Joint (R)

Creates a revolute joint allowing rotation around a single axis between selected parts

Assembly_CreateJointRevolute

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointCylindrical
menus.tip:
Cylindrical Joint (C)

Creates a cylindrical joint that allows rotation around and translation along a single axis

between assembled parts

Assembly_CreateJointCylindrical

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointSlider
menus.tip:
Slider Joint (S)

Creates a slider joint that allows linear movement along a single axis, but restricts rotation

between selected parts

Assembly_CreateJointSlider

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointBall
menus.tip:
Ball Joint (B)

Creates a ball joint that connects parts at a point, allowing unrestricted movement as long

as the connection points remain in contact

Assembly_CreateJointBall

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointDistance
menus.tip:
Distance Joint (D)

Creates a distance joint that fixes the distance between the selected objects

Creates one of several different joints based on the selection. For example, a distance of 0 between a plane and a cylinder creates a tangent joint. A distance of 0 between planes will make them co-planar.

Assembly_CreateJointDistance

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointParallel
menus.tip:
Parallel Joint (N)

Creates a parallel joint that makes the Z-axis of the selected coordinate systems parallel

Assembly_CreateJointParallel

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointPerpendicular
menus.tip:
Perpendicular Joint (M)

Creates a perpendicular joint that makes the Z-axis of the selected coordinate systems

perpendicular

Assembly_CreateJointPerpendicular

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointAngle
menus.tip:
Angle Joint (X)

Creates an angle joint that fixes the angle between the Z-axis of the selected coordinate

systems

Assembly_CreateJointAngle

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointRackPinion
menus.tip:
Rack and Pinion Joint (Q)

Creates a rack and pinion joint that links a part with a slider joint to a part with a revolute joint

Select the same coordinate systems as the revolute and slider joints. The pitch radius defines the movement ratio between the rack and the pinion.

Assembly_CreateJointRackPinion

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointScrew
menus.tip:
Screw Joint (W)

Creates a screw joint that links a part with a slider joint to a part with a revolute joint

Select the same coordinate systems as the revolute and slider joints. The pitch radius defines the movement ratio between the rotating screw and the sliding part.

Assembly_CreateJointScrew

menus.name: Assembly_CreateJointGearBelt
menus.tip: Gears/Belt Joint

menu.tip:
Gears Joint (T)

Creates a gears joint that links 2 rotating gears together. They will have inverse rotation direction.

Select the same coordinate systems as the revolute joints.

Assembly_CreateJointGears

Belt Joint (L)

Creates a belt joint that links 2 rotating objects together. They will have the same rotation direction.

Select the same coordinate systems as the revolute joints.

Assembly_CreateJointBelt
